title: The Outsiders #13 DC 1986 Baxter Mike W. Barr Jim Aparo Cover Watchmen Back Ad
condition_description: Bright front cover with wear along the right edge; back cover toned with a small chip at the lower edge. See photos.
description:
The Outsiders #13 (November 1986), DC Comics - Baxter-paper series. The team stranded on a desert island. Written by Mike W. Barr, cover and art by Jim Aparo. $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: Watchmen house ad (Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons, Dr. Manhattan).

Condition: bright front cover with light wear along the right edge; back cover toned with a small chip at the lower edge (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
